descriptions.w3d_d29g_utility_crate_setup_8004af78: Utility crate setup: applies scale 7, reads Crate.Contents and maps the name to kinds 39 to 58; kinds 54 to 58 take their display text from a Text.kUtility key and return, an unknown name logs and sets an error text; the rest read the utility record's text key and build the display text at +148 as the count (or the encoded glyph when -1), ' x ' and the title.
